title: Violation Log Entry
description: Structured record of a Code of Conduct violation. Includes the control that caught it and the config version involved.

agentDesignation.description: Designation of the agent that violated

configVersion.description: Config version of the agent at time of violation

controlThatCaughtIt.description: Name of the control that detected this violation (e.g., 'Warden review', 'A1 relay gate', 'Budget enforcement')

controlType.description: Whether the control that caught this was Hard (violation was impossible but attempted), Gated (blocked by gate), or Soft (caught by audit)

parentAgent.description: If this agent was spawned by a parent, the parent's designation (for command responsibility per §1.4)

parentResponse.description: Action taken against the parent agent per §VII.3

rootCause.description: Root cause analysis result (completed for Red/Black within 24h per §VII.5)

systemicFix.description: What systemic change prevents recurrence (completed within 48h per §VII.5)

status.description: Current state of the violation record

affectedParties.description: Clients or parties affected, if any

notificationSent.description: Whether affected parties were notified (per §X.4 for breaches)
